short.zh: 汇合两条来路，认出起点
short.en: Merge two ways in, spot the start

t.zh: 街道只能往右或往下走。每个路口的路线数 = 上面 + 左边，起点是 1。
t.en: Streets only go right or down. The routes to a crossing = up + left, and the start is 1.

goal.zh: 让机器人在起点写 1，其余每个路口 = 上面 + 左边。
goal.en: Have the robot write 1 on the start and up + left on every other crossing.

how.zh: 汇合器收上面和左边；放行闸只在起点放一个 1 进去。
how.en: A Merger takes up and left; a Pass gate lets a 1 in at the start only.

body.zh: 这块板从此是一个元件：路线计数器。
body.en: From now on this board is a part: the Route Counter.

hints.zh: 「是起点」接放行闸的条件口，常数 1 接数口，再把放行闸接进汇合器。
hints.en: Wire “is start” to the Pass gate’s condition and a Constant 1 to its number, then the gate into the Merger.
